method: classical-rao-2000 Extended 2026-10-06 (V01): D5/D6/D8/D11 added per the Jaimini/Tajika tradition as implemented in Jagannatha Hora (JHora Traditional method, cross-verified by hora-prakash against JHora reference charts). These four are NOT part of Parasara's Shodasha-varga scheme; significations vary by lineage and are labeled per-source.
source_section: 6.2, printed pages 52-60; later author revisions are separate profiles

5.name: Panchamsha
5.signification: Fame and power; innate morality and spiritual orientation
5.source: Jaimini/Tajika tradition; JHora Traditional method (odd: Aries, Aquarius, Sagittarius, Gemini, Libra; even: Taurus, Virgo, Pisces, Capricorn, Scorpio)

6.name: Shashthamsha
6.signification: Health and disease; enemies and debts
6.source: Jaimini/Tajika tradition; JHora Traditional method (odd signs count from Aries, even from Libra)

8.name: Ashtamsha
8.source: Jaimini/Tajika tradition; JHora Traditional method (movable from Aries, fixed from Sagittarius, dual from Leo)

11.name: Rudramsha
11.signification: Gains, unearned wealth, honors and titles; social network
11.source: Jaimini/Tajika tradition (Ekadashamsha); JHora Traditional Parivritti: ((sign)*11 + part) mod 12. Some lineages read D11 as destructive — variant disclosed, not adopted.
